ex.en: It was online that I sold the clothes.
ex.zh: 我是在網路上賣那些衣服的。

ex.en: She goes online for several hours every day.
ex.zh: 她每天上網好幾個小時。

ex.en: The tickets for this attraction can only be bought online.
ex.zh: 這個景點的門票只能在網路上購買。

online.en: connected to the internet, or using it

ex.en: I took an online course in photography.
ex.zh: 我上了一門線上攝影課。

ex.en: Online shopping is very convenient.
ex.zh: 網路購物非常方便。

online.en: available or done through the internet

ex.en: It's an ongoing investigation.
ex.zh: 調查正在進行中。

ex.en: The project is ongoing.
ex.zh: 這個專案正在進行中。

ex.en: We have ongoing discussions with several suppliers.
ex.zh: 我們正持續和幾家供應商洽談。

ongoing.en: still happening and not yet finished

ex.en: Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.
ex.zh: 把那副撲克牌放在橡木桌上。

ex.en: Your keys are on the table.
ex.zh: 你的鑰匙在桌上。

on.en: touching and supported by a surface

ex.en: You don't have to go to school on Sunday.
ex.zh: 你星期天不用上學。

ex.en: The meeting is on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 會議在星期一早上。

on.en: used before a day or date to show when something happens

ex.en: She gave a talk on climate change.
ex.zh: 她做了一場關於氣候變遷的演講。

ex.en: Do you have any books on marketing?
ex.zh: 你有關於行銷的書嗎？

on.zh: 處於…狀態（on vacation、on sale 等）

ex.en: She would willingly come but she was on vacation.
ex.zh: 她很樂意來，但她正在休假。

ex.en: These shoes are on sale this week.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋這週在特價。

on.en: used to show a state or activity that someone or something is in

ex.en: Is the air conditioner on?
ex.zh: 冷氣開著嗎？

ex.en: What's on TV tonight?
ex.zh: 今晚電視演什麼？

on.en: working because it has been started, or being shown to viewers

ex.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
ex.zh: 我有一個哥哥和兩個妹妹。

ex.en: We need one more chair.
ex.zh: 我們還需要一張椅子。

one.zh: （代替前面提過的名詞）那一個、…的那個

ex.en: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.
ex.zh: 美式廚房比日式廚房大得多。

ex.en: The mother bird brought worms for her young ones.
ex.zh: 母鳥叼蟲回來餵小鳥。

ex.en: I don't like this shirt. Can I see that one?
ex.zh: 我不喜歡這件襯衫，可以看看那件嗎？

one.en: used to avoid repeating a noun that was already mentioned

ex.en: To share one's passion is to live it fully.
ex.zh: 分享自己的熱情，就是充分地活出它。

ex.en: One can't help many, but many can help one.
ex.zh: 一個人幫不了很多人，但很多人能幫助一個人。

one.en: used to mean people in general, including the speaker

ex.en: One day, I'd like to start my own business.
ex.zh: 總有一天我想自己創業。

ex.en: I met her one morning at the station.
ex.zh: 某天早上我在車站遇到她。

one.en: used to talk about a time in the past or future without saying exactly when

ex.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
ex.zh: 你的相機只有我的一半大。

ex.en: It only takes five minutes.
ex.zh: 只要五分鐘就好。

ex.en: Meg was the only girl that was wearing jeans.
ex.zh: 梅格是唯一穿牛仔褲的女生。

ex.en: This letter is the only key to the mystery.
ex.zh: 這封信是解開謎團的唯一線索。

only.en: being the single one of its kind

ex.en: I check my email once a day.
ex.zh: 我一天收一次電子郵件。

ex.en: I've only been to Japan once.
ex.zh: 我只去過日本一次。

ex.en: Once there lived an old man in a village.
ex.zh: 從前，有位老人住在一個村子裡。

ex.en: Once there lived a king whose name was Alfred.
ex.zh: 從前有位名叫阿爾弗雷德的國王。

once.en: at some time in the past

ex.en: Once you finish the report, send it to me.
ex.zh: 報告一完成就寄給我。

ex.en: Once you get used to it, it's easy.
ex.zh: 一旦習慣了，就很簡單。

once.en: used to say that something happens as soon as another thing has happened

ex.en: You had better get away from here at once.
ex.zh: 你最好立刻離開這裡。

ex.en: Start at once, or you will miss the bus.
ex.zh: 馬上出發，不然你會趕不上公車。

ex.en: Having met him before, I recognized him at once.
ex.zh: 因為以前見過他，我立刻就認出他了。

ex.en: Take the medicine at the onset of symptoms.
ex.zh: 症狀一出現就要服藥。

ex.en: The onset of winter brought heavy snow.
ex.zh: 冬天一來就下了大雪。

onset.en: the start of something unpleasant, such as an illness

ex.en: From November onwards, it gets colder.
ex.zh: 從十一月開始，天氣會變冷。

ex.en: I will follow your advice fully from here onwards.
ex.zh: 從現在起，我會完全聽從你的建議。

ex.en: The store is open from 9 a.m. onwards.
ex.zh: 這家店從早上九點開始營業。

ex.en: Onwards and upwards.
ex.zh: 不斷前進，更上一層樓。

ex.en: We walked onwards until we reached the village.
ex.zh: 我們一直往前走，直到抵達村子。

onwards.en: toward the front or in a forward direction

ex.en: I'd like two one-way tickets from A to B.
ex.zh: 麻煩給我兩張從 A 到 B 的單程票。

ex.en: Round trip or one-way?
ex.zh: 來回還是單程？

one-way.en: for travel in one direction only, with no return trip

ex.en: Be careful not to drive the wrong way on a one-way street.
ex.zh: 小心不要在單行道逆向行駛。

ex.en: This is a one-way street, so you can't turn here.
ex.zh: 這是單行道，你不能在這裡轉進去。

one-way.en: allowing traffic to move in one direction only

ex.en: The train arrived on schedule.
ex.zh: 火車準時到了。

ex.en: Summer arrived in June, right on schedule.
ex.zh: 夏天在六月如期到來。

on schedule.en: at the planned time, not early or late

ex.en: Cutting an onion always makes me cry.
ex.zh: 切洋蔥總是讓我流眼淚。

ex.en: Add some chopped onions to the soup.
ex.zh: 在湯裡加一些切碎的洋蔥。

ex.en: She fried the onion until it turned golden.
ex.zh: 她把洋蔥炒到變成金黃色。

ex.en: The cat jumped onto the sofa.
ex.zh: 那隻貓跳到了沙發上。

ex.en: He put the heavy box onto the shelf.
ex.zh: 他把重重的箱子放到架子上。

ex.en: Please move your bag onto the floor.
ex.zh: 請把你的包包移到地上。

ex.en: It is important to take care of oneself when life gets busy.
ex.zh: 生活忙碌時，照顧好自己很重要。

ex.en: Learning to cook for oneself saves a lot of money.
ex.zh: 學會自己煮飯可以省下很多錢。

ex.en: The band walked onstage and the crowd cheered.
ex.zh: 樂團走上舞台，群眾歡呼起來。

ex.en: She was nervous before going onstage.
ex.zh: 上台之前她很緊張。

ex.en: The singer's onstage energy was amazing.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在舞台上的活力太驚人了。

ex.en: They shared a funny onstage moment during the show.
ex.zh: 他們在演出中有一段有趣的舞台時刻。

ex.en: The town survived the onslaught of the storm.
ex.zh: 小鎮撐過了暴風雨的猛烈侵襲。

ex.en: The shop was ready for the onslaught of holiday shoppers.
ex.zh: 商店已為蜂擁而至的假日購物人潮做好準備。

ex.en: A crowd of onlookers gathered around the street performer.
ex.zh: 一群圍觀者聚集在街頭藝人周圍。

ex.en: As a mere onlooker, he did not take part in the argument.
ex.zh: 他只是個旁觀者，沒有參與爭吵。

ex.en: The hikers kept walking onward despite the rain.
ex.zh: 儘管下雨，登山客仍繼續向前走。

ex.en: From that day onward, he never missed a class.
ex.zh: 從那天起，他再也沒有缺過課。

ex.en: The onward journey to the capital took three more days.
ex.zh: 前往首都的後續行程又花了三天。

ex.en: The ticket includes an onward flight to Singapore.
ex.zh: 這張機票包含轉往新加坡的接續班機。

ontario.zh: 安大略湖（北美五大湖之一）

ex.en: Lake Ontario is the smallest of the five Great Lakes by area.
ex.zh: 安大略湖是五大湖中面積最小的一個。

ex.en: We drove along the shore of Ontario and watched the sunset.
ex.zh: 我們沿著安大略湖畔開車，看著夕陽西下。

ex.en: The book discusses an ontological question: what does it mean to exist?
ex.zh: 這本書探討一個存在論的問題：存在是什麼意思？

ex.en: Philosophers have long debated the ontological status of numbers.
ex.zh: 哲學家長期爭論數字在本體論上的地位。

ex.en: Watch out for the oncoming traffic when you cross the road.
ex.zh: 過馬路時要小心迎面而來的車輛。

ex.en: The driver's headlights blinded the oncoming cyclist.
ex.zh: 司機的車燈照得迎面而來的單車騎士睜不開眼。

ex.en: We are preparing for the oncoming winter.
ex.zh: 我們正在為即將來臨的冬天做準備。

ex.en: The farmers worried about the oncoming storm.
ex.zh: 農夫們擔心即將來襲的暴風雨。

ex.en: The onus is on you to prove your claim.
ex.zh: 你有責任證明你的說法。

ex.en: The onus of cleaning up fell on the youngest member.
ex.zh: 打掃的責任落在年紀最小的成員身上。

ex.en: Filling out the long form was an onerous task.
ex.zh: 填寫那份冗長的表格是件繁重的差事。

ex.en: The new rules placed an onerous burden on small shops.
ex.zh: 新規定對小店造成沉重的負擔。

ex.en: The oncologist explained the treatment plan to the patient.
ex.zh: 腫瘤科醫師向病人說明治療計畫。

ex.en: She made an appointment with an oncologist for the next week.
ex.zh: 她預約了下週看腫瘤科醫師。

ex.en: She works in the oncology department of the hospital.
ex.zh: 她在醫院的腫瘤科工作。

ex.en: He studied oncology to help cancer patients.
ex.zh: 他研讀腫瘤學，為了幫助癌症病患。

ex.en: The ceremony celebrates the oneness of the community.
ex.zh: 這場典禮慶祝社區的團結一心。

ex.en: Many people feel a oneness with nature on a hike.
ex.zh: 許多人在健行時感到與大自然合而為一。

ex.en: I think he broke the cup on purpose.
ex.zh: 我覺得他是故意把杯子打破的。

ex.en: She didn't hurt his feelings on purpose.
ex.zh: 她不是故意傷他的心的。

on purpose.en: done deliberately and not by mistake

ex.en: They arrived late on purpose to avoid the crowd.
ex.zh: 他們刻意晚到以避開人潮。

ex.en: Did you leave the door open on purpose?
ex.zh: 你是特地把門開著的嗎？

on purpose.en: done in a way that shows you really meant to do it

ex.en: The train arrived on time this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上火車準時到站。

ex.en: Please be on time for the interview.
ex.zh: 面試請準時到場。

on time.en: at the right or planned moment, not early or late

ex.en: She always pays her rent on time.
ex.zh: 她總是按時繳房租。

ex.en: We finished the project on time despite the problems.
ex.zh: 儘管有些問題，我們還是準時完成了專案。

on time.en: at the agreed moment, for example when paying or handing in work

ex.en: I would like to thank you on behalf of the whole team.
ex.zh: 我想代表整個團隊向你道謝。

ex.en: She accepted the prize on behalf of her class.
ex.zh: 她代表全班領了這個獎。

ex.en: The manager spoke on behalf of all the workers.
ex.zh: 經理代表所有員工發言。

on behalf of.en: as the representative of someone else

ex.en: On average, I sleep about seven hours a night.
ex.zh: 平均來說，我每晚睡大約七小時。

ex.en: Students here spend two hours on homework on average.
ex.zh: 這裡的學生平均每天花兩小時寫作業。

ex.en: Prices went up by three percent on average.
ex.zh: 物價平均上漲了百分之三。

on average.en: as a typical amount when many figures are considered together

ex.en: I'm not angry. On the contrary, I'm very happy.
ex.zh: 我沒有生氣，正好相反，我很開心。

ex.en: "Was it hard?" "On the contrary, it was easy."
ex.zh: 「很難嗎？」「恰恰相反，很簡單。」

on the contrary.en: used to say the opposite of what was just said is true

ex.en: On the whole, I enjoyed the trip.
ex.zh: 整體來說，我很享受這趟旅行。

ex.en: On the whole, the students did well on the test.
ex.zh: 大體上，學生們考得不錯。

ex.en: She put the keys on top of the refrigerator.
ex.zh: 她把鑰匙放在冰箱上面。

ex.en: There was a small flag on top of the sandcastle.
ex.zh: 沙堡的頂端插著一面小旗子。

ex.en: On top of his regular job, he drives a taxi at night.
ex.zh: 除了正職之外，他晚上還開計程車。

ex.en: We missed the bus, and on top of that it started to rain.
ex.zh: 我們錯過了公車，而且還下起雨來。

ex.en: It's hard to stay on top of all my emails.
ex.zh: 要把所有電子郵件都處理好很難。

ex.en: She is always on top of her schoolwork.
ex.zh: 她總是把功課掌握得很好。

on top of.en: fully aware of and able to manage a situation

ex.en: I bought some coffee on the way to the office.
ex.zh: 我在去公司的路上買了咖啡。

ex.en: Let's stop for lunch on the way home.
ex.zh: 我們回家路上停下來吃午餐吧。

ex.en: Don't worry, your order is on the way.
ex.zh: 別擔心，你訂的東西正在送來的路上。

ex.en: Help is on the way, so please stay calm.
ex.zh: 救援就快到了，請保持冷靜。

on the way.en: coming soon and not far away

ex.en: They are so happy because a baby is on the way.
ex.zh: 他們很開心，因為寶寶快要出生了。

ex.en: My sister has two children and a third is on the way.
ex.zh: 我姊姊有兩個孩子，第三個也快出生了。

on the way.en: going to be born in the near future

ex.en: The company offered him the job on the spot.
ex.zh: 公司當場就給了他這份工作。

ex.en: The police fixed the problem on the spot.
ex.zh: 警方當場就處理好了這個問題。

on the spot.en: right at that moment and place

ex.en: The reporter put the mayor on the spot with a hard question.
ex.zh: 記者用一個刁鑽的問題讓市長很難堪。

ex.en: I felt on the spot when everyone looked at me.
ex.zh: 大家都看著我時，我覺得很為難。

on the spot.en: in a difficult situation where you must answer or decide

ex.en: My mom has been on the phone for an hour.
ex.zh: 我媽媽已經講了一個小時的電話。

ex.en: Sorry, I can't talk now because I'm on the phone.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我現在在講電話，不能聊。

on the phone.en: talking to someone using a telephone

ex.en: These shoes are on sale for half price this week.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋這週特價半價。

ex.en: Winter coats go on sale in February.
ex.zh: 冬季外套二月會開始打折。

on sale.en: being sold at a lower price than usual

ex.en: The new phone goes on sale next Friday.
ex.zh: 這支新手機下週五開賣。

ex.en: Tickets for the concert are now on sale online.
ex.zh: 演唱會門票現在開始在網路上販售。

ex.en: You can watch these shows on demand whenever you like.
ex.zh: 你可以隨時隨選觀看這些節目。

ex.en: The bakery makes fresh bread on demand all day.
ex.zh: 這家麵包店整天都按需求現做麵包。

on demand.en: available whenever someone asks for it

ex.en: You can't finish this project on your own.
ex.zh: 你沒辦法一個人完成這個專案。

ex.en: Try to solve the problem on your own before asking for help.
ex.zh: 請求協助之前，先試著自己解決問題。

on your own.en: alone or without help from anyone

ex.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?
ex.zh: 你到底在我房間裡做什麼？

ex.en: Why on earth would anyone leave such a good job?
ex.zh: 到底為什麼會有人離開這麼好的工作？

on earth.en: used after a question word to show surprise or anger

ex.en: She is the kindest person on earth.
ex.zh: 她是世界上最善良的人。

ex.en: Nothing on earth could make me change my mind.
ex.zh: 世上沒有任何事能讓我改變心意。

ex.en: On one hand, I want a bigger house, but on the other, it costs too much.
ex.zh: 一方面我想要更大的房子，另一方面又太貴了。

ex.en: On one hand, the job pays well; on the other, the hours are long.
ex.zh: 一方面這份工作薪水不錯，另一方面工時很長。

on one hand.en: used to introduce the first of two different points

ex.en: He sells handmade soap on the side.
ex.zh: 他兼差賣手工肥皂。

ex.en: She teaches guitar on the side to earn extra money.
ex.zh: 她兼職教吉他來賺外快。

on the side.en: as extra work besides your main job

ex.en: Could I have the sauce on the side, please?
ex.zh: 請問醬汁可以另外放嗎？

ex.en: I ordered a burger with salad on the side.
ex.zh: 我點了漢堡，沙拉另外放。

on the side.en: served separately from the main food

ex.en: All passengers are now on board the plane.
ex.zh: 所有乘客現在都已登機。

ex.en: There were two hundred people on board the ship.
ex.zh: 船上有兩百人。

on board.en: on a ship, train, plane, or bus

ex.en: Our manager is on board with the new idea.
ex.zh: 我們經理贊成這個新點子。

ex.en: We are glad to have you on board.
ex.zh: 我們很高興你加入團隊。

on board.en: agreeing with a plan or joining a team

ex.en: She has been on the go since six this morning.
ex.zh: 她從今天早上六點就忙個不停。

ex.en: With three kids, my sister is always on the go.
ex.zh: 我姊姊有三個孩子，總是忙個不停。

ex.en: The waiter said the dessert was on the house.
ex.zh: 服務生說這份甜點是店家招待。

ex.en: Because we waited so long, the drinks were on the house.
ex.zh: 因為我們等了很久，飲料由店家請客。

on the house.en: given free by a shop or restaurant

ex.en: She was on cloud nine after getting into her dream school.
ex.zh: 她考上夢想的學校後開心得飄飄然。

ex.en: I was on cloud nine on my wedding day.
ex.zh: 我結婚那天開心得像在雲端。

ex.en: After being late again, you are on thin ice with your manager.
ex.zh: 你又遲到了，在經理面前已經如履薄冰。

ex.en: She knew she was on thin ice when she questioned the boss.
ex.zh: 她質疑老闆時，就知道自己處境危險。

on thin ice.en: in a risky situation where one mistake could cause trouble

ex.en: The old barn was on fire when the firefighters arrived.
ex.zh: 消防員抵達時，那間舊穀倉正在燃燒。

ex.en: Quick, the kitchen is on fire!
ex.zh: 快點，廚房著火了！

on fire.zh: 表現超好、手感發燙（口語）

ex.en: Our star player was on fire in the second half.
ex.zh: 我們的明星球員在下半場手感超好。

ex.en: The band was on fire last night.
ex.zh: 那個樂團昨晚的表現超棒。

on hold.zh: 等著通電話; 暫緩; 推遲; 擱置

ex.en: The customer service agent put me on hold for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 客服人員讓我在線上等了十分鐘。

ex.en: Our trip is on hold until the weather gets better.
ex.zh: 我們的旅行暫時擱置，等天氣變好再說。

on hold.en: waiting, or delayed until a later time

ex.en: We went to the market on foot.
ex.zh: 我們步行去市場。

ex.en: It takes about ten minutes to get there on foot.
ex.zh: 走路去那裡大約要十分鐘。

ex.en: The guests came into the room one by one.
ex.zh: 客人一個接一個走進房間。

ex.en: He read the names one by one.
ex.zh: 他把名字一個一個唸出來。

ex.en: My father is traveling on business this week.
ex.zh: 我爸爸這個星期出差。

ex.en: She goes to Tokyo on business twice a year.
ex.zh: 她每年因公去東京兩次。

on business.en: for work and not for fun

ex.en: The nurse was on duty all night.
ex.zh: 那位護理師整晚都在值班。

ex.en: Who is on duty at the front desk today?
ex.zh: 今天誰在櫃檯值班？

on duty.en: working at the time you are supposed to work

ex.en: The Smiths are on holiday in Spain.
ex.zh: 史密斯一家正在西班牙度假。

ex.en: I met my husband while I was on holiday.
ex.zh: 我是在度假時認識我先生的。

on holiday.en: away from work or school for a rest

ex.en: The train drivers are on strike again.
ex.zh: 火車司機又在罷工了。

ex.en: Workers went on strike for better pay.
ex.zh: 工人為了爭取更好的薪水而罷工。

on strike.en: refusing to work as a protest

on second thought.zh: 進一步考慮後,重新思考後,轉念一想

ex.en: On second thought, I'll have tea instead of coffee.
ex.zh: 轉念一想，我還是點茶不點咖啡好了。

ex.en: I was going to say yes, but on second thought, I need time.
ex.zh: 我本來要答應，但再想想，我需要一些時間。

on second thought.en: used when you change your mind after thinking again
